race.comment: DIRTY DEAL (2) just missed in a BM62 over this course and distance two runs back. Dropped back to 1400m last start and couldn't sprint with them in the final stages after racing handy. Back in grade today and returns to his preferred trip. Can make amends. PRESTIGE GEOFFREY (11) turned in last position then flew late to be beaten around a length first-up at Echuca. Suited by a slightly longer trip on a roomier track second-up. Poses a genuine threat. BIG RITA JUNE (8) has found the line okay but been safely held in two runs this time in work, both over shorter journeys. Finds a suitable third-up scenario - expect her to be very strong through the line. DAMELLI (12) passed half the field in the straight last start in a 1200m Gawler Class 1. Needs this type of distance at the fourth run back.
